All those who are born on this earth have to depart from this mortal world some day. The deaths, in general, occur naturally as per the expectancy of life computed in any given country. Nevertheless, cases of unexpected or inopportune deaths do also get reported simultaneously. These inopportune deaths are caused by incidents, accidents or negligences (e.g. natural calamity, accident, suicide etc.).
